# Third-party license data

`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` at the repository root is generated by `scripts/gen-notices.mjs`
(`just notices`). It ships with every release artifact. The files here only exist to fill in
license texts that `cargo bundle-licenses` cannot find.

Most Rust crates bundle their own `LICENSE` file, which the generator reads straight from the
crate. Some published tarballs leave it out (usually workspace members whose crate metadata
does not `include` the workspace `LICENSE`); for those `cargo bundle-licenses` emits
`NOT FOUND`, and the generator looks here:

- `overrides.json`
  - `repositories` — text per `repository` URL and SPDX id, for crates whose upstream repo has
    the license file. The files live under `upstream/<owner>__<repo>/` (copied from the repo at
    the version in `Cargo.lock`).
  - `canonical` — the SPDX template for an id (`canonical/<id>.txt`), used when the upstream has
    no license file at all (e.g. projects that only put `SPDX-License-Identifier` headers in
    their sources).
  - `crates` — per-package text for the rare case none of the above fits (only `r-efi`'s unused
    LGPL option today).

To refresh after a dependency upgrade, run `just notices`; if it reports a crate with no
license text, add the upstream file (or point at `canonical/`) in `overrides.json`.
